description:
Welcome to the Madring — 5.416 kilometres through IFEMA and Valdebebas, 22 corners, 57 laps, and Formula One's eighty-first circuit. Nobody has raced here.

🔹 Straight Mode zones? Two. The main straight, from the exit of Turn 22 across the start line to Turn 1, and the run from Turn 3 to Turn 4. Overtake detection sits before Turn 22, with activation on its exit.

title: 2026 F1 Italian GP race analysis by Peter Windsor
description: Sir Lewis Hamilton finished only P6 for Ferrari but for the Tifosi at Monza there was still much about which to go crazy: Kimi Antonelli, the boy from Bologna, started his Mercedes from P19, led the race, dropped to P6 in a tyre change - and then regained the lead to win. It was an epic drive in an epic, baking-hot race and it marked the first home win for an Italian driver at Monza since Ludovico Scarfiotti headed a Ferrari one-two there in 1966.
